sentences.text: This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.140/2014 registered at Police Station Petlawad, Jhabua (M.P.) under Sections 420/120-B, 467/120-B, 468/120-B, 471/120-B of the IPC.
According to the prosecution, it is alleged that a sim has been obtained by preparing fake documents by a person named Gangaram and the said sim card has been used by the present applicant.

On the basis aforesaid, the offence were registered under section 420/120-B, 467/120-B, 468/120-B,
471/120-B of the IPC.
One Sandeep Joshi lodged a report that after recording of his statement, he was threatened by the present applicant and thus, he violated the terms and conditions of the bail.
The applicant is in jail since 16.01.2023.
The case is still at evidence stage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the report has been lodged by Sandeep Joshi after recording of the Court statement.
In the Court statement, he has not supported the prosecution case and has turned hostile and therefore, there was no occasion for the applicant to threaten him.
A false case has been prepared.

Learned counsel for the respondent/state opposed the prayer and submits that still about six prosecution witnesses are yet to be examined and there may be possibility of influencing and threatening them.

After hearing learned counsel for the applicant and taking into consideration that the report of threatening was lodged by Sandeep Joshi after recording of the statement, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed on the following conditions that he shall not approach or threaten the remaining prosecution witnesses and if any report is received in this regard, the prosecution may file application for cancellation of bail.

It is directed that applicant shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.

The prison authorities are also requested to ensure compliance with the order passed by the Supreme Court IN RE : CONTAGION OF COVID 19 VIRUS IN PRISONS in SUO MOTU "W.P. (C)
No.1/2020" and ensure that the applicant is examined by the jail doctor before release.

If the applicant shows symptoms of COVID-19, the doctor shall forthwith direct applicant to be produced before the appropriate hospital designated for the detection and treatment of COVID-19 patients.
If the doctor is of the opinion that the applicant is not affected with the virus, the jail authorities shall ensure transportation from the jail till the place of residence.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Sourabh Prakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72815451/
